svg.title: IUS supporter petition - reconstructed spread
svg.desc: Source-derived re-typesetting of the visible petition panel with the reconstructed supporter form. Body wording is interpreted across the supplied photographs, which contain reflections and partial occlusion; punctuation and line breaks are modern reconstruction choices, not a certified diplomatic transcription. Unreadable fine-print statement on the form is omitted. Historical phone, amount and campaign wording are archival content.

g.aria-label: YOUR PERSONAL, $5 SUPPORTER PETITION IS VITAL!
You've probably heard that we're petitioning Victoria for a university
centred in Prince George. We need every person of voting age on
that petition - but there's a hitch...
We're asking you to contribute $5 to make your signature really
"talk" - in a loud, clear voice - to our elected representatives. An
independent university makes excellent sense for us:
- it will encourage our kids to remain in the North
- it will be a major factor in Northern economic development
- it will encourage more of our young people to attain a
university education designed for employment in the North
Call the Interior University Society at 562-6868 if you have any
questions OR, PLEASE COMPLETE AND RETURN THIS PETITION
ALONG WITH YOUR CHEQUE FOR $5 PAYABLE TO THE INTERIOR
The City of Prince George and the staff at City Hall are helping
us with our campaign and will forward it to us.

g.title: Ius Supporter Card Reconstructed
g.desc: Rebuilt supporter-only form from the right-hand panel of the photographed yellow petition spread. $5 NON-VOTING wording is transcribed. Fine statement microcopy is omitted, and cell counts are approximate. Historic artwork for reference, not a current registration form.
